# Cleared
> Export document checking for Pakistani exporters. Invoice, packing list, bill of lading and LC or PO compared field by field, reviewed by a person before you submit to the bank.

Upload your documents. An agent reads them, code compares every shared field, and a person signs off the mismatch report. Your first 10 orders are free. After that you pay after your report arrives, and we refund our fee if the corrected set fails our checklist.
